Part II · Chapter 4第二部分 · 第 4 章

Identifiability可辨识性

The Darmois–Skitovich theorem and Comon's theorem: with at most one Gaussian source, the mixing matrix is determined up to scaling and permutation.

Darmois–Skitovich 定理与 Comon 定理：至多一个高斯源时，混合矩阵在尺度与置换意义下唯一。

4.1 What identifiability means可辨识性的含义

Chapter 1 showed that the order and the scale of the sources can never be recovered (Proposition 1.3命题 1.3), and Chapter 3第 3 章 showed that second-order statistics determine the mixing matrix only up to a rotation. This chapter answers the question that these two facts raise: is anything else lost? Suppose we knew the distribution of x\bxx exactly, as if we had infinitely many noiseless samples. Would it determine A\bAA up to the unavoidable order and scale? The answer is the central theorem of ICA: yes, provided at most one source is Gaussian. Without that proviso the answer is no, and we will see exactly what is lost.

第 1 章说明，源的顺序与尺度永远无法恢复（Proposition 1.3命题 1.3）；Chapter 3第 3 章说明，二阶统计量只能把混合矩阵确定到一个旋转。这两个事实自然引出本章要回答的问题：除此之外还会丢失什么？假设我们确切知道 x\bxx 的分布，好比拥有无穷多个无噪声样本，它能否在顺序与尺度这两种不可避免的不确定性之外唯一确定 A\bAA？答案正是 ICA 的核心定理：只要至多有一个源是高斯的，就能。去掉这个条件，答案就是否定的，我们还会看清到底丢失了什么。

Identifiability is a property of the model, not of an algorithm. It asks whether two different parameter values can produce the same distribution of the observations. If they can, no amount of data and no estimator can tell them apart. If they cannot, the remaining tasks are to build contrast functions whose optima are the true parameters (Chapters 5 and 6), algorithms that find those optima (Part III), and a theory of how accurately this can be done from TTT samples (Chapter 10第 10 章).

可辨识性是模型的性质，而不是算法的性质。它问的是：两个不同的参数值能否产生同一个观测分布？如果能，那么无论数据有多少、用什么估计量，都无法把它们区分开。如果不能，剩下的任务才是：构造以真实参数为最优点的对比函数（第 5、6 章），设计找到这些最优点的算法（第三部分），以及建立从 TTT 个样本出发能估计到多准的理论（Chapter 10第 10 章）。

Definition 4.1 (identifiability)定义 4.1（可辨识性）

Consider models x=As\bx = \bA\bsx=As in which A∈Rm×n\bA \in \R^{m \times n}A∈Rm×n has full column rank and s\bss has mutually independent, non-degenerate components (a random variable is degenerate if it is almost surely constant). The mixing matrix is identifiable in a class of such models if, whenever two members (A,s)(\bA, \bs)(A,s) and (B,t)(\bB, \bt)(B,t) of the class produce observations with the same distribution, As=dBt\bA\bs \overset{d}{=} \bB\btAs=dBt, there are a permutation matrix Π\bPiΠ and an invertible diagonal matrix D\bDD with B=AΠD\bB = \bA\bPi\bDB=AΠD.

考虑这样一类模型 x=As\bx = \bA\bsx=As：A∈Rm×n\bA \in \R^{m \times n}A∈Rm×n 列满秩，s\bss 的各分量相互独立且非退化（随机变量退化是指它几乎必然为常数）。如果该类中任意两个成员 (A,s)(\bA, \bs)(A,s) 与 (B,t)(\bB, \bt)(B,t) 只要产生同分布的观测，即 As=dBt\bA\bs \overset{d}{=} \bB\btAs=dBt，就必然存在置换矩阵 Π\bPiΠ 与可逆对角矩阵 D\bDD，使 B=AΠD\bB = \bA\bPi\bDB=AΠD，则称混合矩阵在这一类模型中可辨识。

The condition B=AΠD\bB = \bA\bPi\bDB=AΠD says that each column of B\bBB is a nonzero multiple of a different column of A\bAA. Since DΠ=Π(Π⊤DΠ)\bD\bPi = \bPi(\bPi^\top\bD\bPi)DΠ=Π(Π⊤DΠ) and Π⊤DΠ\bPi^\top\bD\bPiΠ⊤DΠ is again diagonal, it does not matter on which side of the permutation the diagonal factor stands; we call any such product a scaled permutation matrix. Degenerate sources are excluded because a source that is identically zero could be attached to any column.

条件 B=AΠD\bB = \bA\bPi\bDB=AΠD 的意思是：B\bBB 的每一列都是 A\bAA 中某一列（各不相同）的非零倍数。由于 DΠ=Π(Π⊤DΠ)\bD\bPi = \bPi(\bPi^\top\bD\bPi)DΠ=Π(Π⊤DΠ)，而 Π⊤DΠ\bPi^\top\bD\bPiΠ⊤DΠ 仍是对角矩阵，对角因子写在置换矩阵的哪一侧无关紧要；这样的乘积统称为带尺度的置换矩阵。之所以排除退化的源，是因为一个恒为零的源可以配上任意一列。

Two facts frame the problem. First, if all sources are Gaussian, identifiability fails completely: for s∼N(0,I)\bs \sim \Ncal(\bzero, \bI)s∼N(0,I) and every orthogonal Q\bQQ, the pair (AQ⊤,Qs)(\bA\bQ^\top, \bQ\bs)(AQ⊤,Qs) produces the same observations as (A,s)(\bA, \bs)(A,s) (Section 3.5第 3.5 节). Second, for unit-variance sources the covariance Cx=AA⊤\bC_{\bx} = \bA\bA^\topCx​=AA⊤ determines A\bAA up to a right orthogonal factor: if BB⊤=AA⊤\bB\bB^\top = \bA\bA^\topBB⊤=AA⊤ then B=AQ\bB = \bA\bQB=AQ with Q\bQQ orthogonal. The question is therefore whether the non-Gaussian structure of the sources forces Q\bQQ to be a signed permutation. The key tool is a classical characterization of the Gaussian law.

有两个事实界定了问题的范围。其一，如果所有源都是高斯的，可辨识性完全失效：对 s∼N(0,I)\bs \sim \Ncal(\bzero, \bI)s∼N(0,I) 与任意正交矩阵 Q\bQQ，(AQ⊤,Qs)(\bA\bQ^\top, \bQ\bs)(AQ⊤,Qs) 与 (A,s)(\bA, \bs)(A,s) 产生相同的观测（Section 3.5第 3.5 节）。其二，对单位方差的源，协方差 Cx=AA⊤\bC_{\bx} = \bA\bA^\topCx​=AA⊤ 把 A\bAA 确定到右乘一个正交因子：若 BB⊤=AA⊤\bB\bB^\top = \bA\bA^\topBB⊤=AA⊤，则 B=AQ\bB = \bA\bQB=AQ，其中 Q\bQQ 为正交矩阵。于是问题归结为：源的非高斯结构能否迫使 Q\bQQ 成为带符号的置换矩阵？关键工具是高斯分布的一个经典刻画。

4.2 The Darmois–Skitovich theoremDarmois–Skitovich 定理

When can two linear combinations of the same independent variables be independent of each other? Trivially, when they share no variable. For Gaussian variables sharing is allowed: if s1,s2s_1, s_2s1​,s2​ are independent N(0,1)\Ncal(0, 1)N(0,1), then s1+s2s_1 + s_2s1​+s2​ and s1−s2s_1 - s_2s1​−s2​ are jointly Gaussian and uncorrelated, hence independent. The theorem of Darmois (1953) and Skitovich (1953) says that the Gaussian is the only law with this property.

同一组独立变量的两个线性组合，什么时候彼此独立？不共享任何变量时显然独立。高斯变量则允许共享：若 s1,s2s_1, s_2s1​,s2​ 是独立的 N(0,1)\Ncal(0, 1)N(0,1) 变量，则 s1+s2s_1 + s_2s1​+s2​ 与 s1−s2s_1 - s_2s1​−s2​ 联合高斯且不相关，因而独立。Darmois（1953）与 Skitovich（1953）的定理指出，具有这种性质的只有高斯分布。

Theorem 4.2 (Darmois–Skitovich)定理 4.2（Darmois–Skitovich）

Let s1,…,sns_1, \dots, s_ns1​,…,sn​ be mutually independent random variables and a1,…,ana_1, \dots, a_na1​,…,an​, b1,…,bnb_1, \dots, b_nb1​,…,bn​ real numbers. If the linear forms L1=∑i=1naisiL_1 = \sum_{i=1}^n a_i s_iL1​=∑i=1n​ai​si​ and L2=∑i=1nbisiL_2 = \sum_{i=1}^n b_i s_iL2​=∑i=1n​bi​si​ are independent, then every sis_isi​ with aibi≠0a_i b_i \neq 0ai​bi​=0 is Gaussian.

设 s1,…,sns_1, \dots, s_ns1​,…,sn​ 是相互独立的随机变量，a1,…,ana_1, \dots, a_na1​,…,an​ 与 b1,…,bnb_1, \dots, b_nb1​,…,bn​ 是实数。若线性形式 L1=∑i=1naisiL_1 = \sum_{i=1}^n a_i s_iL1​=∑i=1n​ai​si​ 与 L2=∑i=1nbisiL_2 = \sum_{i=1}^n b_i s_iL2​=∑i=1n​bi​si​ 相互独立，则凡满足 aibi≠0a_i b_i \neq 0ai​bi​=0 的 sis_isi​ 都是高斯的。

Here and below a constant counts as a degenerate Gaussian. The theorem restricts only the variables that appear in both forms. With s1s_1s1​ Laplacian, s2s_2s2​ uniform and g1,g2g_1, g_2g1​,g2​ independent standard Gaussians, the forms L1=s1+g1+g2L_1 = s_1 + g_1 + g_2L1​=s1​+g1​+g2​ and L2=s2+g1−g2L_2 = s_2 + g_1 - g_2L2​=s2​+g1​−g2​ are independent: g1+g2g_1 + g_2g1​+g2​ and g1−g2g_1 - g_2g1​−g2​ are independent Gaussians, and each form adds to one of them a variable that the other form does not contain. The shared variables g1g_1g1​ and g2g_2g2​ are Gaussian, as the theorem demands. Uncorrelatedness, by contrast, is cheap: for independent s1,s2s_1, s_2s1​,s2​ with unit variance and kurtosis κ\kappaκ, the forms y1=s1+s2y_1 = s_1 + s_2y1​=s1​+s2​ and y2=s1−s2y_2 = s_1 - s_2y2​=s1​−s2​ are always uncorrelated, but their cross-cumulant cum⁡(y1,y1,y2,y2)\cum(y_1, y_1, y_2, y_2)cum(y1​,y1​,y2​,y2​) equals 2κ2\kappa2κ (Exercise 4.1习题 4.1), which is −2.4-2.4−2.4 for uniform and 666 for Laplacian sources.

这里以及下文都把常数视为退化的高斯变量。定理只约束同时出现在两个线性形式中的变量。设 s1s_1s1​ 服从拉普拉斯分布，s2s_2s2​ 服从均匀分布，g1,g2g_1, g_2g1​,g2​ 是独立的标准高斯变量，则 L1=s1+g1+g2L_1 = s_1 + g_1 + g_2L1​=s1​+g1​+g2​ 与 L2=s2+g1−g2L_2 = s_2 + g_1 - g_2L2​=s2​+g1​−g2​ 相互独立：g1+g2g_1 + g_2g1​+g2​ 与 g1−g2g_1 - g_2g1​−g2​ 是独立的高斯变量，而两个形式各自在其中一个上加了一个另一形式不含的变量。被共享的 g1g_1g1​ 与 g2g_2g2​ 正是高斯的，与定理一致。相比之下，不相关是很廉价的性质：对方差为一、峭度为 κ\kappaκ 的独立变量 s1,s2s_1, s_2s1​,s2​，y1=s1+s2y_1 = s_1 + s_2y1​=s1​+s2​ 与 y2=s1−s2y_2 = s_1 - s_2y2​=s1​−s2​ 总是不相关，但它们的交叉累积量 cum⁡(y1,y1,y2,y2)\cum(y_1, y_1, y_2, y_2)cum(y1​,y1​,y2​,y2​) 等于 2κ2\kappa2κ（Exercise 4.1习题 4.1），对均匀源为 −2.4-2.4−2.4，对拉普拉斯源为 666。

Two facts about the Gaussian law关于高斯分布的两个事实

The proof rests on two classical results whose proofs use the theory of entire functions; we state them without proof.

证明依赖两个经典结果，它们的证明要用到整函数理论，这里只陈述、不证明。

Fact 4.3 (Marcinkiewicz, 1939)事实 4.3（Marcinkiewicz，1939）

If the characteristic function φu(t)=E[eitu]\varphi_u(t) = \E[e^{\mathrm{i}tu}]φu​(t)=E[eitu] of a random variable uuu, where i=−1\mathrm{i} = \sqrt{-1}i=−1​, has the form φu(t)=eP(t)\varphi_u(t) = e^{P(t)}φu​(t)=eP(t) for all real ttt, with PPP a polynomial, then PPP has degree at most two, so uuu is Gaussian.

若随机变量 uuu 的特征函数 φu(t)=E[eitu]\varphi_u(t) = \E[e^{\mathrm{i}tu}]φu​(t)=E[eitu]（i=−1\mathrm{i} = \sqrt{-1}i=−1​）对一切实数 ttt 都具有 φu(t)=eP(t)\varphi_u(t) = e^{P(t)}φu​(t)=eP(t) 的形式，其中 PPP 是多项式，则 PPP 的次数不超过二，因而 uuu 是高斯的。

Fact 4.4 (Cramér, 1936)事实 4.4（Cramér，1936）

If uuu and vvv are independent and u+vu + vu+v is Gaussian, then uuu and vvv are both Gaussian. By induction, if a finite sum of independent variables is Gaussian, so is every summand.

若 uuu 与 vvv 独立且 u+vu + vu+v 是高斯的，则 uuu 与 vvv 都是高斯的。由归纳法，若有限个独立变量之和是高斯的，则每个加项都是高斯的。

Recall from Chapter 2第 2 章 that when a variable uuu has finite moments mr=E[ur]m_r = \E[u^r]mr​=E[ur] of every order, its cumulants κr(u)\kappa_r(u)κr​(u) are defined by the identity of formal power series ∑r≥0mrzr/r!=exp⁡(∑r≥1κr(u)zr/r!)\sum_{r \ge 0} m_r z^r / r! = \exp\bigl(\sum_{r \ge 1} \kappa_r(u) z^r / r!\bigr)∑r≥0​mr​zr/r!=exp(∑r≥1​κr​(u)zr/r!), that is, by the Taylor expansion of the log-characteristic function at the origin. The next lemma shows that a variable whose cumulants vanish beyond some order is Gaussian. It needs no assumption that the law is determined by its moments: the vanishing of the cumulants forces this by itself.

回忆Chapter 2第 2 章：若变量 uuu 的各阶矩 mr=E[ur]m_r = \E[u^r]mr​=E[ur] 都有限，则其累积量 κr(u)\kappa_r(u)κr​(u) 由形式幂级数恒等式 ∑r≥0mrzr/r!=exp⁡(∑r≥1κr(u)zr/r!)\sum_{r \ge 0} m_r z^r / r! = \exp\bigl(\sum_{r \ge 1} \kappa_r(u) z^r / r!\bigr)∑r≥0​mr​zr/r!=exp(∑r≥1​κr​(u)zr/r!) 定义，也就是对数特征函数在原点的泰勒展开。下面的引理说明，累积量从某阶起全部为零的变量必是高斯的。它不需要“分布由矩唯一确定”这一假设：累积量的消失本身就保证了这一点。

Lemma 4.5 (finitely many nonzero cumulants)引理 4.5（只有有限个非零累积量）

Let uuu have finite moments of all orders, and suppose that κr(u)=0\kappa_r(u) = 0κr​(u)=0 for every r>Kr > Kr>K. Then uuu is Gaussian.

设 uuu 的各阶矩都有限，且对一切 r>Kr > Kr>K 有 κr(u)=0\kappa_r(u) = 0κr​(u)=0，则 uuu 是高斯的。

令 P(z)=∑r=1Kκr(u)zr/r!P(z) = \sum_{r=1}^{K} \kappa_r(u) z^r / r!P(z)=∑r=1K​κr​(u)zr/r!。由假设，∑rmrzr/r!\sum_r m_r z^r / r!∑r​mr​zr/r! 正是整函数 eP(z)e^{P(z)}eP(z) 的泰勒级数，因此对任意复数 zzz 绝对收敛，其导数级数 ∑rmr+1zr/r!\sum_r m_{r+1} z^r / r!∑r​mr+1​zr/r! 也是如此。对实数 x>0x > 0x>0，rrr 为偶数时 E∣u∣r=mr\E|u|^r = m_rE∣u∣r=mr​，rrr 为奇数时 E∣u∣r≤1+mr+1\E|u|^r \le 1 + m_{r+1}E∣u∣r≤1+mr+1​（因为 r+1r + 1r+1 为偶数时 ∣v∣r≤1+vr+1|v|^r \le 1 + v^{r+1}∣v∣r≤1+vr+1）。于是对任意 xxx 都有 E ex∣u∣=∑rxrE∣u∣r/r!<∞\E\, e^{x|u|} = \sum_r x^r \E|u|^r / r! < \inftyEex∣u∣=∑r​xrE∣u∣r/r!<∞。有了这个控制，特征函数就可以逐项展开：对一切实数 ttt，φu(t)=E eitu=∑rmr(it)r/r!=eP(it)\varphi_u(t) = \E\, e^{\mathrm{i}tu} = \sum_r m_r (\mathrm{i}t)^r / r! = e^{P(\mathrm{i}t)}φu​(t)=Eeitu=∑r​mr​(it)r/r!=eP(it)。由于 t↦P(it)t \mapsto P(\mathrm{i}t)t↦P(it) 是多项式，Fact 4.3事实 4.3表明其次数不超过二，故 uuu 是高斯的。

Proof when all moments are finite各阶矩有限时的证明

We prove Theorem 4.2定理 4.2 under the additional assumption that every sis_isi​ has finite moments of all orders. The general case, which needs no moments at all, requires a more delicate analysis of characteristic functions; see Kagan, Linnik & Rao (1973).

我们在附加假设“每个 sis_isi​ 的各阶矩都有限”之下证明Theorem 4.2定理 4.2。完全不需要矩条件的一般情形，要对特征函数做更精细的分析，见 Kagan, Linnik & Rao（1973）。

Proof (all moments finite).证明（各阶矩有限的情形）

Step 1: cross-cumulants vanish. The two classical ingredients play different roles. The Vandermonde step needs no property of the Gaussian at all; it shows that independence kills all but finitely many cumulants of each group uku_kuk​. Marcinkiewicz's theorem turns "finitely many cumulants" into "Gaussian", and Cramér's theorem is needed only when several shared variables enter both forms in the same proportion, so that the cumulant equations see only their sum.

两个经典结果各司其职。Vandermonde 一步完全没有用到高斯分布的性质，它说明独立性使每组 uku_kuk​ 只剩下有限个非零累积量。Marcinkiewicz 定理把“只有有限个累积量”变成“是高斯的”；Cramér 定理只在若干共享变量以相同比例进入两个线性形式时才需要，因为此时累积量方程只能看到它们的和。

4.3 Comon's theoremComon 定理

Comon (1994) observed that the Darmois–Skitovich theorem settles the identifiability of ICA. The argument works directly with the global matrix P=WA\bP = \bW\bAP=WA, which maps the sources to the outputs, y=Ps\by = \bP\bsy=Ps.

Comon（1994）注意到，Darmois–Skitovich 定理解决了 ICA 的可辨识性问题。论证直接针对把源映射到输出的全局矩阵 P=WA\bP = \bW\bAP=WA 进行，即 y=Ps\by = \bP\bsy=Ps。

Theorem 4.6 (Comon)定理 4.6（Comon）

Let s=(s1,…,sn)⊤\bs = (s_1, \dots, s_n)^\tops=(s1​,…,sn​)⊤ have mutually independent, non-degenerate components with finite variances, at most one of which is Gaussian, and let P∈Rn×n\bP \in \R^{n \times n}P∈Rn×n be invertible. If the components of y=Ps\by = \bP\bsy=Ps are pairwise independent, then P=ΠD\bP = \bPi\bDP=ΠD for some permutation matrix Π\bPiΠ and invertible diagonal matrix D\bDD. In particular, the components of y\byy are then mutually independent.

设 s=(s1,…,sn)⊤\bs = (s_1, \dots, s_n)^\tops=(s1​,…,sn​)⊤ 的各分量相互独立、非退化且方差有限，其中至多一个是高斯的；设 P∈Rn×n\bP \in \R^{n \times n}P∈Rn×n 可逆。若 y=Ps\by = \bP\bsy=Ps 的各分量两两独立，则存在置换矩阵 Π\bPiΠ 与可逆对角矩阵 D\bDD，使 P=ΠD\bP = \bPi\bDP=ΠD。特别地，此时 y\byy 的各分量相互独立。

Proof.证明

Take two rows i≠ji \neq ji=j. The outputs yi=∑kPiksky_i = \sum_k P_{ik} s_kyi​=∑k​Pik​sk​ and yj=∑kPjksky_j = \sum_k P_{jk} s_kyj​=∑k​Pjk​sk​ are independent, so by Theorem 4.2定理 4.2 every sks_ksk​ with PikPjk≠0P_{ik} P_{jk} \neq 0Pik​Pjk​=0 is Gaussian. Hence each column kkk that belongs to a non-Gaussian source has at most one nonzero entry, and at least one because P\bPP is invertible. These columns are multiples of standard basis vectors and are linearly independent, so their nonzero entries lie in distinct rows. If no source is Gaussian, this already says P=ΠD\bP = \bPi\bDP=ΠD.

任取两行 i≠ji \neq ji=j。输出 yi=∑kPiksky_i = \sum_k P_{ik} s_kyi​=∑k​Pik​sk​ 与 yj=∑kPjksky_j = \sum_k P_{jk} s_kyj​=∑k​Pjk​sk​ 独立，由Theorem 4.2定理 4.2，凡满足 PikPjk≠0P_{ik} P_{jk} \neq 0Pik​Pjk​=0 的 sks_ksk​ 都是高斯的。因此，对应非高斯源的每一列 kkk 至多有一个非零元；又因 P\bPP 可逆，至少有一个。这些列都是标准基向量的倍数，且线性无关，所以它们的非零元位于不同的行。若没有高斯源，这已经说明 P=ΠD\bP = \bPi\bDP=ΠD。

Otherwise let sgs_gsg​ be the Gaussian source. The n−1n - 1n−1 non-Gaussian columns occupy n−1n - 1n−1 distinct rows; let rrr be the remaining row. Row rrr is zero outside column ggg, so yr=Prgsgy_r = P_{rg} s_gyr​=Prg​sg​, and Prg≠0P_{rg} \neq 0Prg​=0 because P\bPP is invertible. Any other row iii has the form yi=Pilsl+Pigsgy_i = P_{il} s_l + P_{ig} s_gyi​=Pil​sl​+Pig​sg​, where lll is the non-Gaussian column whose nonzero entry sits in row iii. Independent variables with finite variance are uncorrelated, so 0=Cov⁡(yi,yr)=PigPrgVar⁡(sg)0 = \Cov(y_i, y_r) = P_{ig} P_{rg} \Var(s_g)0=Cov(yi​,yr​)=Pig​Prg​Var(sg​), which forces Pig=0P_{ig} = 0Pig​=0. Thus column ggg also has a single nonzero entry, and P=ΠD\bP = \bPi\bDP=ΠD. Finally, ΠDs\bPi\bD\bsΠDs has mutually independent components (Proposition 1.3命题 1.3).

否则，设 sgs_gsg​ 是那个高斯源。n−1n - 1n−1 个非高斯列占据了 n−1n - 1n−1 个不同的行，记剩下的一行为 rrr。第 rrr 行在第 ggg 列以外全为零，所以 yr=Prgsgy_r = P_{rg} s_gyr​=Prg​sg​；又因 P\bPP 可逆，Prg≠0P_{rg} \neq 0Prg​=0。其余任一行 iii 都形如 yi=Pilsl+Pigsgy_i = P_{il} s_l + P_{ig} s_gyi​=Pil​sl​+Pig​sg​，其中 lll 是非零元恰在第 iii 行的那个非高斯列。方差有限的独立变量互不相关，故 0=Cov⁡(yi,yr)=PigPrgVar⁡(sg)0 = \Cov(y_i, y_r) = P_{ig} P_{rg} \Var(s_g)0=Cov(yi​,yr​)=Pig​Prg​Var(sg​)，这迫使 Pig=0P_{ig} = 0Pig​=0。于是第 ggg 列也只有一个非零元，即 P=ΠD\bP = \bPi\bDP=ΠD。最后，ΠDs\bPi\bD\bsΠDs 的各分量相互独立（Proposition 1.3命题 1.3）。

The Gaussian column needs the separate covariance step because the Darmois–Skitovich theorem places no restriction on a Gaussian variable shared by two forms. Applied to the ICA model, the theorem gives identifiability.

高斯列之所以需要单独的协方差论证，是因为 Darmois–Skitovich 定理对两个线性形式共享的高斯变量没有任何限制。把这个定理用到 ICA 模型上，就得到可辨识性。

Corollary 4.7 (identifiability with at most one Gaussian source)推论 4.7（至多一个高斯源时的可辨识性）

Let x=As\bx = \bA\bsx=As satisfy Assumption 1.1假设 1.1, with non-degenerate sources of finite variance.

  1. If W∈Rn×m\bW \in \R^{n \times m}W∈Rn×m makes WA\bW\bAWA invertible and the components of y=Wx\by = \bW\bxy=Wx pairwise independent, then WA=ΠD\bW\bA = \bPi\bDWA=ΠD: the outputs are the sources up to order and scale.
  2. The mixing matrix is identifiable: if As=dBt\bA\bs \overset{d}{=} \bB\btAs=dBt where (B,t)(\bB, \bt)(B,t) also satisfies these assumptions, then B=AΠD\bB = \bA\bPi\bDB=AΠD.

设 x=As\bx = \bA\bsx=As 满足Assumption 1.1假设 1.1，且各源非退化、方差有限。

  1. 若 W∈Rn×m\bW \in \R^{n \times m}W∈Rn×m 使 WA\bW\bAWA 可逆，并使 y=Wx\by = \bW\bxy=Wx 的各分量两两独立，则 WA=ΠD\bW\bA = \bPi\bDWA=ΠD：输出就是在顺序与尺度意义下的源。
  2. 混合矩阵可辨识：若 As=dBt\bA\bs \overset{d}{=} \bB\btAs=dBt，且 (B,t)(\bB, \bt)(B,t) 也满足上述假设，则 B=AΠD\bB = \bA\bPi\bDB=AΠD。

Proof.证明

Part 1 is Theorem 4.6定理 4.6 applied to P=WA\bP = \bW\bAP=WA. For part 2, the covariance of x\bxx is AΣsA⊤=BΣtB⊤\bA\bSigma_{\bs}\bA^\top = \bB\bSigma_{\bt}\bB^\topAΣs​A⊤=BΣt​B⊤ with positive definite diagonal Σs\bSigma_{\bs}Σs​ and Σt\bSigma_{\bt}Σt​, so A\bAA and B\bBB have the same column space. Let A+\bA^{+}A+ be the pseudo-inverse, so that A+A=I\bA^{+}\bA = \bIA+A=I and AA+\bA\bA^{+}AA+ is the orthogonal projector onto that column space; then AM=B\bA\bM = \bBAM=B for M=A+B\bM = \bA^{+}\bBM=A+B, and M\bMM is invertible because B\bBB has rank nnn. Applying A+\bA^{+}A+ to both sides of As=dBt\bA\bs \overset{d}{=} \bB\btAs=dBt gives s=dMt\bs \overset{d}{=} \bM\bts=dMt, so Mt\bM\btMt has mutually independent components. By Theorem 4.6定理 4.6 applied to t\btt, M=ΠD\bM = \bPi\bDM=ΠD, and B=AΠD\bB = \bA\bPi\bDB=AΠD.

第 1 条就是把Theorem 4.6定理 4.6用于 P=WA\bP = \bW\bAP=WA。对第 2 条，x\bxx 的协方差为 AΣsA⊤=BΣtB⊤\bA\bSigma_{\bs}\bA^\top = \bB\bSigma_{\bt}\bB^\topAΣs​A⊤=BΣt​B⊤，其中 Σs\bSigma_{\bs}Σs​ 与 Σt\bSigma_{\bt}Σt​ 是正定对角矩阵，所以 A\bAA 与 B\bBB 的列空间相同。记 A+\bA^{+}A+ 为伪逆，则 A+A=I\bA^{+}\bA = \bIA+A=I，且 AA+\bA\bA^{+}AA+ 是到该列空间的正交投影；于是对 M=A+B\bM = \bA^{+}\bBM=A+B 有 AM=B\bA\bM = \bBAM=B，又因 B\bBB 的秩为 nnn，M\bMM 可逆。对 As=dBt\bA\bs \overset{d}{=} \bB\btAs=dBt 两边作用 A+\bA^{+}A+，得 s=dMt\bs \overset{d}{=} \bM\bts=dMt，所以 Mt\bM\btMt 的各分量相互独立。对 t\btt 应用Theorem 4.6定理 4.6，得 M=ΠD\bM = \bPi\bDM=ΠD，从而 B=AΠD\bB = \bA\bPi\bDB=AΠD。

Two features of Theorem 4.6定理 4.6 deserve emphasis. First, pairwise independence of the outputs is enough. For general random vectors pairwise independence is much weaker than mutual independence (Exercise 4.2习题 4.2), but for invertible linear transforms of independent sources the two coincide. It is therefore enough, in principle, to make the outputs independent pair by pair. The algorithm of Comon (1994) is built on this: it sweeps repeatedly over the pairs of outputs, rotating each pair to optimize a contrast, and JADE uses the same pairwise Jacobi sweeps (Chapter 9第 9 章). Second, the theorem justifies the notion of a contrast function (Comon, 1994): any criterion that is optimized only when the outputs are independent is optimized only at separating matrices. The mutual information of the outputs in Chapter 6第 6 章 is the canonical example.

Theorem 4.6定理 4.6有两点值得强调。第一，输出两两独立就足够了。对一般的随机向量，两两独立远弱于相互独立（Exercise 4.2习题 4.2）；但对独立源的可逆线性变换，两者是一回事。因此，原则上只需让输出两两独立即可。Comon（1994）的算法正是建立在这一点之上：它反复扫描各对输出，每次旋转一对输出以优化对比函数；JADE 也采用同样的成对 Jacobi 扫描（Chapter 9第 9 章）。第二，该定理为对比函数的概念提供了依据（Comon, 1994）：凡是只在输出独立时才取到最优的准则，都只在分离矩阵处取到最优。Chapter 6第 6 章中输出的互信息就是最典型的例子。

4.4 Several Gaussian sources多个高斯源

The condition "at most one Gaussian source" cannot be dropped, but its failure is confined to the Gaussian sources. The next example shows the obstruction; the theorem after it shows that it does not spread to the non-Gaussian sources.

“至多一个高斯源”这一条件不能去掉，但它失效时，影响只局限于高斯源本身。下面的例子展示这一障碍，随后的定理说明它不会波及非高斯源。

Example 4.8 (a continuum of solutions)例 4.8（一族连续的解）

Let s1,s2s_1, s_2s1​,s2​ be independent N(0,1)\Ncal(0, 1)N(0,1) and let s3,…,sns_3, \dots, s_ns3​,…,sn​ be independent non-Gaussian sources with unit variance, independent of s1,s2s_1, s_2s1​,s2​. For an angle θ\thetaθ, let Qθ\bQ_\thetaQθ​ rotate the (1,2)(1, 2)(1,2) coordinate plane by θ\thetaθ and leave the other coordinates fixed. The first two components of Qθs\bQ_\theta\bsQθ​s are jointly Gaussian with identity covariance, hence independent standard Gaussians, and they remain independent of s3,…,sns_3, \dots, s_ns3​,…,sn​; so Qθs=ds\bQ_\theta\bs \overset{d}{=} \bsQθ​s=ds. Consequently (AQθ⊤,Qθs)(\bA\bQ_\theta^\top, \bQ_\theta\bs)(AQθ⊤​,Qθ​s) produces the same observations as (A,s)(\bA, \bs)(A,s) for every θ\thetaθ, while AQθ⊤\bA\bQ_\theta^\topAQθ⊤​ is of the form AΠD\bA\bPi\bDAΠD only when θ\thetaθ is a multiple of π/2\pi/2π/2. The data are compatible with a one-parameter family of mixing matrices.

设 s1,s2s_1, s_2s1​,s2​ 是独立的 N(0,1)\Ncal(0, 1)N(0,1) 变量，s3,…,sns_3, \dots, s_ns3​,…,sn​ 是方差为一、相互独立的非高斯源，且与 s1,s2s_1, s_2s1​,s2​ 独立。对角度 θ\thetaθ，令 Qθ\bQ_\thetaQθ​ 在 (1,2)(1, 2)(1,2) 坐标平面内旋转 θ\thetaθ，其余坐标不动。Qθs\bQ_\theta\bsQθ​s 的前两个分量联合高斯且协方差为单位阵，因此是独立的标准高斯变量，并且仍与 s3,…,sns_3, \dots, s_ns3​,…,sn​ 独立；所以 Qθs=ds\bQ_\theta\bs \overset{d}{=} \bsQθ​s=ds。于是对任意 θ\thetaθ，(AQθ⊤,Qθs)(\bA\bQ_\theta^\top, \bQ_\theta\bs)(AQθ⊤​,Qθ​s) 与 (A,s)(\bA, \bs)(A,s) 产生相同的观测，而 AQθ⊤\bA\bQ_\theta^\topAQθ⊤​ 只有在 θ\thetaθ 为 π/2\pi/2π/2 的整数倍时才具有 AΠD\bA\bPi\bDAΠD 的形式。与数据相容的混合矩阵构成一个单参数族。

Theorem 4.9 (partial identifiability)定理 4.9（部分可辨识性）

Let s\bss have mutually independent, non-degenerate components with finite variances; let s1,…,sn−ks_1, \dots, s_{n-k}s1​,…,sn−k​ be non-Gaussian and sn−k+1,…,sns_{n-k+1}, \dots, s_nsn−k+1​,…,sn​ Gaussian, with diagonal covariance ΣG\bSigma_GΣG​. Let P∈Rn×n\bP \in \R^{n \times n}P∈Rn×n be invertible and suppose the components of y=Ps\by = \bP\bsy=Ps are pairwise independent. Then there is a permutation matrix Π\bPiΠ such that

设 s\bss 的各分量相互独立、非退化且方差有限；其中 s1,…,sn−ks_1, \dots, s_{n-k}s1​,…,sn−k​ 非高斯，sn−k+1,…,sns_{n-k+1}, \dots, s_nsn−k+1​,…,sn​ 是高斯的，其协方差为对角矩阵 ΣG\bSigma_GΣG​。设 P∈Rn×n\bP \in \R^{n \times n}P∈Rn×n 可逆，且 y=Ps\by = \bP\bsy=Ps 的各分量两两独立。则存在置换矩阵 Π\bPiΠ，使

ΠP=(D00M),(4.2)\bPi\bP = \begin{pmatrix} \bD & \bzero \\ \bzero & \bM \end{pmatrix},\tag{4.2}ΠP=(D0​0M​),(4.2)

where D\bDD is an invertible (n−k)×(n−k)(n-k) \times (n-k)(n−k)×(n−k) diagonal matrix and M\bMM is an invertible k×kk \times kk×k matrix with MΣGM⊤\bM\bSigma_G\bM^\topMΣG​M⊤ diagonal. Conversely, every such P\bPP makes the components of Ps\bP\bsPs mutually independent.

其中 D\bDD 是 (n−k)×(n−k)(n-k) \times (n-k)(n−k)×(n−k) 可逆对角矩阵，M\bMM 是使 MΣGM⊤\bM\bSigma_G\bM^\topMΣG​M⊤ 为对角矩阵的 k×kk \times kk×k 可逆矩阵。反之，任何这样的 P\bPP 都使 Ps\bP\bsPs 的各分量相互独立。

Proof.证明

As in the proof of Theorem 4.6定理 4.6, the Darmois–Skitovich theorem shows that each non-Gaussian column of P\bPP has exactly one nonzero entry, and that these n−kn - kn−k entries lie in distinct rows. Let RRR be the set of the other kkk rows and M\bMM the k×kk \times kk×k block of P\bPP formed by the rows in RRR and the Gaussian columns. The rows in RRR vanish outside the Gaussian columns, so yR=MsG\by_R = \bM\bs_GyR​=MsG​, where sG=(sn−k+1,…,sn)⊤\bs_G = (s_{n-k+1}, \dots, s_n)^\topsG​=(sn−k+1​,…,sn​)⊤; these kkk rows of the invertible P\bPP are linearly independent and supported on kkk columns, so M\bMM is invertible.

与Theorem 4.6定理 4.6的证明一样，由 Darmois–Skitovich 定理知，P\bPP 的每个非高斯列恰有一个非零元，且这 n−kn - kn−k 个非零元位于不同的行。记其余 kkk 行构成的集合为 RRR，记 M\bMM 为 P\bPP 中由 RRR 中各行与高斯列构成的 k×kk \times kk×k 子块。RRR 中各行在高斯列以外全为零，所以 yR=MsG\by_R = \bM\bs_GyR​=MsG​，其中 sG=(sn−k+1,…,sn)⊤\bs_G = (s_{n-k+1}, \dots, s_n)^\topsG​=(sn−k+1​,…,sn​)⊤；这 kkk 行是可逆矩阵 P\bPP 的行，线性无关，又只在 kkk 个列上取非零值，所以 M\bMM 可逆。

Now take a row i∉Ri \notin Ri∈/R; it has the form yi=Pilsl+pi⊤sGy_i = P_{il} s_l + \mathbf{p}_i^\top\bs_Gyi​=Pil​sl​+pi⊤​sG​, where lll is its non-Gaussian column and pi\mathbf{p}_ipi​ collects its entries in the Gaussian columns. For each r∈Rr \in Rr∈R, independence of yiy_iyi​ and yry_ryr​ gives 0=Cov⁡(yi,yr)0 = \Cov(y_i, y_r)0=Cov(yi​,yr​); stacking these kkk equations gives MΣGpi=0\bM\bSigma_G\mathbf{p}_i = \bzeroMΣG​pi​=0, and since MΣG\bM\bSigma_GMΣG​ is invertible, pi=0\mathbf{p}_i = \bzeropi​=0. Ordering the rows as the non-Gaussian rows followed by RRR produces (4.2). Finally, yR=MsG\by_R = \bM\bs_GyR​=MsG​ is a Gaussian vector with covariance MΣGM⊤\bM\bSigma_G\bM^\topMΣG​M⊤; its components are pairwise independent, hence uncorrelated, so this matrix is diagonal.

再取一行 i∉Ri \notin Ri∈/R，它形如 yi=Pilsl+pi⊤sGy_i = P_{il} s_l + \mathbf{p}_i^\top\bs_Gyi​=Pil​sl​+pi⊤​sG​，其中 lll 是该行对应的非高斯列，pi\mathbf{p}_ipi​ 汇集了该行在高斯列上的元素。对每个 r∈Rr \in Rr∈R，由 yiy_iyi​ 与 yry_ryr​ 独立得 0=Cov⁡(yi,yr)0 = \Cov(y_i, y_r)0=Cov(yi​,yr​)；把这 kkk 个方程合在一起，就是 MΣGpi=0\bM\bSigma_G\mathbf{p}_i = \bzeroMΣG​pi​=0，而 MΣG\bM\bSigma_GMΣG​ 可逆，故 pi=0\mathbf{p}_i = \bzeropi​=0。把各行排成“先非高斯行、后 RRR 中各行”的顺序，就得到 (4.2)。最后，yR=MsG\by_R = \bM\bs_GyR​=MsG​ 是协方差为 MΣGM⊤\bM\bSigma_G\bM^\topMΣG​M⊤ 的高斯向量；其分量两两独立，因而不相关，所以这个矩阵是对角的。

For the converse, the first n−kn - kn−k outputs of ΠPs\bPi\bP\bsΠPs are dlsld_l s_ldl​sl​, functions of distinct non-Gaussian sources, and the remaining outputs MsG\bM\bs_GMsG​ are a function of the Gaussian sources only. The latter are jointly Gaussian and uncorrelated, hence mutually independent, so all nnn outputs are mutually independent.

反过来，ΠPs\bPi\bP\bsΠPs 的前 n−kn - kn−k 个输出是 dlsld_l s_ldl​sl​，分别只依赖于不同的非高斯源；其余输出 MsG\bM\bs_GMsG​ 只依赖于高斯源。后者联合高斯且互不相关，因而相互独立，所以全部 nnn 个输出相互独立。

In terms of the mixing matrix, write A=[AN AG]\bA = [\bA_N \ \bA_G]A=[AN​ AG​] with the columns of the non-Gaussian and the Gaussian sources. A matrix W\bWW that produces pairwise independent outputs with P=WA\bP = \bW\bAP=WA invertible implies the mixing matrix AP−1=[AND−1  AGM−1] Π\bA\bP^{-1} = [\bA_N\bD^{-1} \ \ \bA_G\bM^{-1}]\,\bPiAP−1=[AN​D−1  AG​M−1]Π, because x=AP−1y\bx = \bA\bP^{-1}\byx=AP−1y. The non-Gaussian columns are recovered individually, up to scale and order, exactly as in Corollary 4.7推论 4.7. The Gaussian columns are replaced by AGM−1\bA_G\bM^{-1}AG​M−1, which spans the same subspace as AG\bA_GAG​ but is otherwise arbitrary. Only the Gaussian subspace span(AG)\mathrm{span}(\bA_G)span(AG​) is identified. After whitening, with unit-variance outputs, M\bMM is orthogonal: any rotation inside the Gaussian subspace is as good as any other. The case k=1k = 1k=1 is Theorem 4.6定理 4.6 again, since a 1×11 \times 11×1 block is diagonal.

用混合矩阵的语言来说，把 A\bAA 按非高斯源与高斯源分块为 A=[AN AG]\bA = [\bA_N \ \bA_G]A=[AN​ AG​]。若 W\bWW 使输出两两独立且 P=WA\bP = \bW\bAP=WA 可逆，则由 x=AP−1y\bx = \bA\bP^{-1}\byx=AP−1y，它所对应的混合矩阵为 AP−1=[AND−1  AGM−1] Π\bA\bP^{-1} = [\bA_N\bD^{-1} \ \ \bA_G\bM^{-1}]\,\bPiAP−1=[AN​D−1  AG​M−1]Π。非高斯列被逐个恢复，只差尺度与顺序，与Corollary 4.7推论 4.7完全相同。高斯列则被替换成 AGM−1\bA_G\bM^{-1}AG​M−1：它与 AG\bA_GAG​ 张成同一个子空间，除此之外是任意的。能被辨识的只有高斯子空间 span(AG)\mathrm{span}(\bA_G)span(AG​)。白化并把输出归一化为单位方差之后，M\bMM 是正交矩阵：高斯子空间内的任何旋转都同样合格。k=1k = 1k=1 时，1×11 \times 11×1 的块自然是对角的，结论又回到Theorem 4.6定理 4.6。

In practice this means that an ICA algorithm applied to data with several Gaussian sources returns some basis of the Gaussian subspace, chosen by its initialization and by sampling noise. Such components change from run to run, while the non-Gaussian components stay put. This situation arises, for instance, when the model order is overestimated and several noise dimensions, often close to Gaussian, enter the decomposition; Chapter 11第 11 章 discusses how to detect it (Section 11.5第 11.5 节).

在实践中，这意味着：对含多个高斯源的数据运行 ICA，算法会返回高斯子空间的某一组基，具体是哪一组取决于初始化和抽样噪声。这些成分每次运行都会变化，而非高斯成分保持不变。例如，当模型阶数估计过高、若干往往接近高斯的噪声维度进入分解时，就会出现这种情况；Chapter 11第 11 章讨论如何发现它（Section 11.5第 11.5 节）。

4.5 Identifiability, separability and uniqueness可辨识性、可分离性与唯一性

Eriksson & Koivunen (2004) distinguished three properties of the model x=As\bx = \bA\bsx=As that coincide in the square case but come apart in general:

Eriksson & Koivunen（2004）区分了模型 x=As\bx = \bA\bsx=As 的三种性质，它们在方阵情形下是一回事，一般情形下则各不相同：

  • Identifiability. The columns of A\bAA are determined by the distribution of x\bxx up to scale and order (Definition 4.1定义 4.1; when m<nm < nm<n, full column rank is replaced by the requirement that no column be zero).
  • Separability. A matrix W\bWW exists for which Wx\bW\bxWx has independent, non-degenerate components, and every such W\bWW recovers the sources: Wx=ΠDs\bW\bx = \bPi\bD\bsWx=ΠDs.
  • Uniqueness. The model is identifiable and, in addition, the distributions of the sources are determined up to scale and order.
  • 可辨识性。A\bAA 的各列由 x\bxx 的分布在尺度与顺序意义下唯一确定（Definition 4.1定义 4.1；当 m<nm < nm<n 时，把列满秩条件换成没有零列）。
  • 可分离性。存在使 Wx\bW\bxWx 各分量独立且非退化的矩阵 W\bWW，并且任何这样的 W\bWW 都能恢复源：Wx=ΠDs\bW\bx = \bPi\bD\bsWx=ΠDs。
  • 唯一性。模型可辨识，并且源的分布也在尺度与顺序意义下唯一确定。

Under Assumption 1.1假设 1.1, with non-degenerate sources of finite variance, all three hold. Corollary 4.7推论 4.7 gives identifiability, and also separability, because independent non-degenerate outputs force WA\bW\bAWA to be invertible: a linear relation among the outputs would make one of them a function of the others, hence independent of itself and therefore constant. Since the sources s=A+x\bs = \bA^{+}\bxs=A+x are then determined up to scale and order, so are their distributions. With more sources than sensors (m<nm < nm<n) the properties separate. The model is never separable: WA\bW\bAWA has rank at most m<nm < nm<n, so the nnn outputs satisfy a linear relation and cannot be independent and non-degenerate. Yet the mixing matrix can still be identifiable: if no source is Gaussian and no two columns of A\bAA are collinear, then A\bAA is identifiable within the class of models whose sources are all non-Gaussian and whose mixing matrices have no two collinear columns (Eriksson & Koivunen, 2004, building on Kagan, Linnik & Rao, 1973). Uniqueness can fail even then: if every source contains an independent Gaussian component, Gaussian variance can sometimes be moved from one source to another without changing the distribution of x\bxx (Exercise 4.5习题 4.5). Chapter 12第 12 章 develops the overcomplete case (Theorem 12.1定理 12.1).

在Assumption 1.1假设 1.1之下（源非退化且方差有限），三者都成立。Corollary 4.7推论 4.7给出可辨识性，也给出可分离性，因为相互独立且非退化的输出迫使 WA\bW\bAWA 可逆：若各输出之间存在线性关系，其中某个输出就是其余输出的函数，从而与自身独立，只能是常数。既然源 s=A+x\bs = \bA^{+}\bxs=A+x 在尺度与顺序意义下已被确定，它们的分布自然也被确定。源多于传感器（m<nm < nm<n）时，三者就分开了。此时模型永远不可分离：WA\bW\bAWA 的秩至多为 m<nm < nm<n，所以 nnn 个输出之间存在线性关系，不可能既相互独立又非退化。但混合矩阵仍可能可辨识：若没有高斯源、且 A\bAA 没有两列共线，则在“源都非高斯、混合矩阵没有共线列”的模型类中，A\bAA 是可辨识的（Eriksson & Koivunen, 2004，其基础是 Kagan, Linnik & Rao, 1973 的定理）。即便如此，唯一性仍可能不成立：如果每个源都含有一个独立的高斯成分，有时可以把高斯方差从一个源挪到另一个源，而不改变 x\bxx 的分布（Exercise 4.5习题 4.5）。Chapter 12第 12 章专门讨论过完备情形（Theorem 12.1定理 12.1）。

Other models, other answers换一个模型，换一个答案

Identifiability always refers to a model class, and changing the class changes the answer. The standard model treats the samples as independent draws (Assumption 1.1假设 1.1, item 4), and the Gaussian obstruction is a consequence of ignoring time. If the sources are stationary time series with unit variance and autocorrelations ρi(τ)=E[si(t)si(t−τ)]\rho_i(\tau) = \E[s_i(t)s_i(t-\tau)]ρi​(τ)=E[si​(t)si​(t−τ)], the lagged covariances E[x(t)x(t−τ)⊤]=A diag⁡(ρ1(τ),…,ρn(τ)) A⊤\E[\bx(t)\bx(t-\tau)^\top] = \bA\,\diag(\rho_1(\tau), \dots, \rho_n(\tau))\,\bA^\topE[x(t)x(t−τ)⊤]=Adiag(ρ1​(τ),…,ρn​(τ))A⊤ identify A\bAA even when every source is Gaussian, provided that for each pair of sources some lag distinguishes their autocorrelations (Theorem 9.6定理 9.6). In the other direction, a general nonlinear mixture x=f(s)\bx = \mathbf{f}(\bs)x=f(s) is not identifiable at all: independent components can be manufactured from any random vector by a suitable nonlinear map (Hyvärinen & Pajunen, 1999; Theorem 13.2定理 13.2). Identifiability returns, up to componentwise transformations, when the sources are modulated by an observed auxiliary variable and suitable variability conditions hold (Theorem 13.5定理 13.5).

可辨识性总是相对于某一类模型而言的，换一类模型，答案就会改变。标准模型把样本视为独立抽样（Assumption 1.1假设 1.1第 4 条），高斯源造成的障碍正是忽略时间顺序的后果。如果源是方差为一的平稳时间序列，自相关为 ρi(τ)=E[si(t)si(t−τ)]\rho_i(\tau) = \E[s_i(t)s_i(t-\tau)]ρi​(τ)=E[si​(t)si​(t−τ)]，那么滞后协方差 E[x(t)x(t−τ)⊤]=A diag⁡(ρ1(τ),…,ρn(τ)) A⊤\E[\bx(t)\bx(t-\tau)^\top] = \bA\,\diag(\rho_1(\tau), \dots, \rho_n(\tau))\,\bA^\topE[x(t)x(t−τ)⊤]=Adiag(ρ1​(τ),…,ρn​(τ))A⊤ 即使在所有源都是高斯时也能辨识 A\bAA，只要对每一对源都有某个滞后能区分它们的自相关（Theorem 9.6定理 9.6）。反方向上，一般的非线性混合 x=f(s)\bx = \mathbf{f}(\bs)x=f(s) 完全不可辨识：从任何随机向量出发，都可以用适当的非线性映射造出独立成分（Hyvärinen & Pajunen, 1999；Theorem 13.2定理 13.2）。当源受一个可观测的辅助变量调制、且满足适当的变化性条件时，可辨识性又在逐分量变换的意义下恢复（Theorem 13.5定理 13.5）。

4.6 Identifiable is not the same as easy to estimate可辨识不等于容易估计

Identifiability is a statement about infinite data and says nothing about how many samples are needed. A source that is non-Gaussian but close to Gaussian is identifiable, yet the statistics that tell it apart from a Gaussian are small and must be estimated from data. The experiment below makes this visible. Each source is a normalized sum of kkk independent uniform variables; it has unit variance and kurtosis −1.2/k-1.2/k−1.2/k (cumulants add over independent summands), and it approaches a Gaussian as kkk grows. Two such sources are rotated by a random angle, and the angle is recovered by maximizing the absolute kurtosis of a projection over a grid of directions, as in Section 1.5第 1.5 节; the fourth moments of all projections are computed from the five fourth-order moments of z\bzz.

可辨识性是关于无穷多数据的论断，对需要多少样本只字未提。一个非高斯但接近高斯的源是可辨识的，但把它与高斯区分开的那些统计量很小，而且必须从数据中估计。下面的实验让这一点一目了然。每个源是 kkk 个独立均匀变量的归一化和：方差为一，峭度为 −1.2/k-1.2/k−1.2/k（累积量对独立加项可加），kkk 越大越接近高斯。把两个这样的源旋转一个随机角度，再像Section 1.5第 1.5 节那样，在一组方向上搜索投影峭度绝对值的最大值来恢复这个角度；所有投影的四阶矩都由 z\bzz 的五个四阶矩算出。

import numpy as np

rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
T, runs = 5000, 500
th = np.linspace(0, np.pi, 1800, endpoint=False)    # all directions (w ~ -w)
c, s = np.cos(th), np.sin(th)

def source(k):
    """Normalized sum of k unit-variance uniforms: kurtosis -1.2 / k."""
    u = rng.uniform(-np.sqrt(3), np.sqrt(3), (k, T))
    return u.sum(axis=0) / np.sqrt(k)

for k in [1, 2, 4, 8]:
    err = []
    for _ in range(runs):
        a = rng.uniform(0, np.pi / 2)                   # true rotation angle
        Q = np.array([[np.cos(a), -np.sin(a)], [np.sin(a), np.cos(a)]])
        z = Q @ np.vstack([source(k), source(k)])       # whitened mixture
        m = [np.mean(z[0]**(4 - j) * z[1]**j) for j in range(5)]
        m4 = (c**4 * m[0] + 4 * c**3 * s * m[1] + 6 * c**2 * s**2 * m[2]
              + 4 * c * s**3 * m[3] + s**4 * m[4])     # E[(w^T z)^4]
        m2 = (c**2 * np.mean(z[0]**2) + 2 * c * s * np.mean(z[0] * z[1])
              + s**2 * np.mean(z[1]**2))                # E[(w^T z)^2]
        d = (th[np.argmax(np.abs(m4 - 3 * m2**2))] - a) % (np.pi / 2)
        err.append(min(d, np.pi / 2 - d))               # error modulo pi/2
    rms = np.degrees(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(err))))
    print(f"k = {k}: kurtosis {-1.2 / k:+.2f}, rms error {rms:5.2f} deg")

The script prints root-mean-square angle errors of 0.95, 2.09, 5.51 and 13.33 degrees for k=1,2,4,8k = 1, 2, 4, 8k=1,2,4,8. Each halving of the kurtosis multiplies the error by a little more than two, and at k=8k = 8k=8 the error is already half of what a random guess gives: an angle error uniform on [0,π/4][0, \pi/4][0,π/4] has root-mean-square (π/4)/3≈26(\pi/4)/\sqrt{3} \approx 26(π/4)/3​≈26 degrees. Better contrasts than kurtosis (Chapter 6第 6 章) change the numbers but cannot remove the effect. Chapter 10第 10 章 makes this precise: the Cramér–Rao bound on the separation error of two sources grows without bound as their Fisher informations approach the Gaussian value (Theorem 10.10定理 10.10). It is the finite-sample counterpart of Example 4.8例 4.8: exactly Gaussian sources cannot be separated at all, and nearly Gaussian sources can be separated only with many samples.

脚本对 k=1,2,4,8k = 1, 2, 4, 8k=1,2,4,8 分别输出 0.95、2.09、5.51 和 13.33 度的均方根角度误差。峭度每减半，误差就变为原来的两倍多；到 k=8k = 8k=8 时，误差已达随机猜测水平的一半：在 [0,π/4][0, \pi/4][0,π/4] 上均匀分布的角度误差，其均方根为 (π/4)/3≈26(\pi/4)/\sqrt{3} \approx 26(π/4)/3​≈26 度。换用比峭度更好的对比函数（Chapter 6第 6 章）会改变这些数字，但消除不了这一效应。Chapter 10第 10 章将把这一点说得更精确：当两个源的 Fisher 信息趋于高斯分布的取值时，分离误差的 Cramér–Rao 界趋于无穷（Theorem 10.10定理 10.10）。这正是Example 4.8例 4.8在有限样本下的对应：严格高斯的源根本无法分离，接近高斯的源只有在样本很多时才能分离。

Key points

本章要点

  • Identifiability is a property of the model: the distribution of x\bxx must determine A\bAA up to a scaled permutation of its columns. Without it, no algorithm can succeed.
  • Darmois–Skitovich: two independent linear forms in independent variables can share only Gaussian variables. With all moments finite, the proof combines vanishing cross-cumulants, a Vandermonde system, and the theorems of Marcinkiewicz and Cramér.
  • Comon: if at most one source is Gaussian and P\bPP is invertible, pairwise independence of the components of Ps\bP\bsPs forces P=ΠD\bP = \bPi\bDP=ΠD. Hence ICA is identifiable, and pairwise independence of the outputs already implies separation.
  • With k≥2k \ge 2k≥2 Gaussian sources, the non-Gaussian sources are still identified individually, but the Gaussian ones only through the subspace they span, with a free k×kk \times kk×k rotation after whitening.
  • Identifiability, separability and uniqueness differ beyond the square model; temporal structure and auxiliary variables change what is identifiable; and identifiable sources that are nearly Gaussian need many samples.
  • 可辨识性是模型的性质：x\bxx 的分布必须在列的带尺度置换意义下确定 A\bAA。缺少这一性质，任何算法都无法成功。
  • Darmois–Skitovich 定理：独立变量的两个相互独立的线性形式只能共享高斯变量。在各阶矩有限时，证明由交叉累积量为零、Vandermonde 方程组以及 Marcinkiewicz 与 Cramér 的定理组合而成。
  • Comon 定理：若至多一个源是高斯的且 P\bPP 可逆，则 Ps\bP\bsPs 各分量两两独立迫使 P=ΠD\bP = \bPi\bDP=ΠD。因此 ICA 可辨识，且输出两两独立就已意味着分离成功。
  • 有 k≥2k \ge 2k≥2 个高斯源时，非高斯源仍能逐个辨识，而高斯源只能通过它们张成的子空间来辨识，白化后还剩一个任意的 k×kk \times kk×k 旋转。
  • 超出方阵模型后，可辨识性、可分离性与唯一性各不相同；时间结构与辅助变量会改变哪些量可辨识；接近高斯的源虽然可辨识，却需要大量样本。

The other two outputs are M(s2,s3)⊤\bM(s_2, s_3)^\topM(s2​,s3​)⊤, an arbitrary orthonormal recombination of the Gaussian sources. The solution set is a union of finitely many circles (three positions for ±s1\pm s_1±s1​, two signs, and the two components of O(2)O(2)O(2)), so it is one-dimensional: one free angle, as in Example 4.8例 4.8.

对正交（因而可逆）矩阵 P=UA~\bP = \bU\tilde\bAP=UA~ 应用Theorem 4.9定理 4.9，其中 k=2k = 2k=2，ΣG=I\bSigma_G = \bIΣG​=I：存在置换矩阵 Π\bPiΠ，使 ΠUA~=(d00M)\bPi\bU\tilde\bA = \bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} d & \bzero \\ \bzero & \bM \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)ΠUA~=(d0​0M​)。这个矩阵是正交的，所以它的对角块也正交：d=±1d = \pm 1d=±1，M∈O(2)\bM \in O(2)M∈O(2)，而此时 MM⊤=I\bM\bM^\top = \bIMM⊤=I 自然是对角的。反之，任何这样的矩阵都给出独立的输出。因此 U=Π⊤(±100M)A~⊤\bU = \bPi^\top \bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} \pm 1 & \bzero \\ \bzero & \bM \end{smallmatrix}\bigr) \tilde\bA^\topU=Π⊤(±10​0M​)A~⊤，其中 M\bMM 是任意 2×22 \times 22×2 旋转或反射。有一个输出等于 ±s1\pm s_1±s1​：拉普拉斯源在符号与位置意义下被恢复。另外两个输出是 M(s2,s3)⊤\bM(s_2, s_3)^\topM(s2​,s3​)⊤，即高斯源的任意标准正交重组。解集是有限个圆的并（±s1\pm s_1±s1​ 的三个位置、两种符号，以及 O(2)O(2)O(2) 的两个连通分支），因此是一维的：恰有一个自由角度，与Example 4.8例 4.8一致。

Let m=2m = 2m=2, n=4n = 4n=4 and ai=(cos⁡αi,sin⁡αi)⊤\ba_i = (\cos\alpha_i, \sin\alpha_i)^\topai​=(cosαi​,sinαi​)⊤ with αi=(i−1)π/4\alpha_i = (i - 1)\pi/4αi​=(i−1)π/4. 设 m=2m = 2m=2，n=4n = 4n=4，ai=(cos⁡αi,sin⁡αi)⊤\ba_i = (\cos\alpha_i, \sin\alpha_i)^\topai​=(cosαi​,sinαi​)⊤，其中 αi=(i−1)π/4\alpha_i = (i - 1)\pi/4αi​=(i−1)π/4。令 si=ui+gis_i = u_i + g_isi​=ui​+gi​，其中 u1,…,u4,g1,…,g4u_1, \dots, u_4, g_1, \dots, g_4u1​,…,u4​,g1​,…,g4​ 相互独立，每个 uiu_iui​ 服从方差为一的均匀分布，gi∼N(0,σi2)g_i \sim \Ncal(0, \sigma_i^2)gi​∼N(0,σi2​)。（a）求不全为零的数 δ1,…,δ4\delta_1, \dots, \delta_4δ1​,…,δ4​，使 ∑iδiaiai⊤=0\sum_i \delta_i \ba_i\ba_i^\top = \bzero∑i​δi​ai​ai⊤​=0。（b）证明把 σi2=1\sigma_i^2 = 1σi2​=1 换成 σi2=1+εδi\sigma_i^2 = 1 + \varepsilon\delta_iσi2​=1+εδi​（∣ε∣<1|\varepsilon| < 1∣ε∣<1）不改变 x=∑isiai\bx = \sum_i s_i \ba_ix=∑i​si​ai​ 的分布。（c）由此说明：尽管没有高斯源、A\bAA 也没有两列共线，源的分布却不唯一。

Show solution查看解答

(a) The four matrices aiai⊤\ba_i\ba_i^\topai​ai⊤​ are (1000)\bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)(10​00​), 12(1111)\tfrac12\bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)21​(11​11​), (0001)\bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)(00​01​) and 12(1−1−11)\tfrac12\bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} 1 & -1 \\ -1 & 1 \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)21​(1−1​−11​); they must be linearly dependent because symmetric 2×22 \times 22×2 matrices form a three-dimensional space. Indeed δ=(1,−1,1,−1)\delta = (1, -1, 1, -1)δ=(1,−1,1,−1) works: the (1,1)(1,1)(1,1) entry is 1−12+0−12=01 - \tfrac12 + 0 - \tfrac12 = 01−21​+0−21​=0, the (1,2)(1,2)(1,2) entry is 0−12+0+12=00 - \tfrac12 + 0 + \tfrac12 = 00−21​+0+21​=0, and the (2,2)(2,2)(2,2) entry is 0−12+1−12=00 - \tfrac12 + 1 - \tfrac12 = 00−21​+1−21​=0. (b) Write x=∑iuiai+g\bx = \sum_i u_i \ba_i + \mathbf{g}x=∑i​ui​ai​+g with g=∑igiai\mathbf{g} = \sum_i g_i \ba_ig=∑i​gi​ai​. The two terms are independent, and g\mathbf{g}g is Gaussian with covariance ∑iσi2aiai⊤\sum_i \sigma_i^2 \ba_i\ba_i^\top∑i​σi2​ai​ai⊤​, which does not change when σi2=1\sigma_i^2 = 1σi2​=1 is replaced by 1+εδi1 + \varepsilon\delta_i1+εδi​ (these are positive for ∣ε∣<1|\varepsilon| < 1∣ε∣<1). The first term does not change either, and the law of a sum of independent vectors is determined by the laws of the summands, so the law of x\bxx is unchanged. (c) Each source si=ui+gis_i = u_i + g_isi​=ui​+gi​ has kurtosis −1.2-1.2−1.2 (the Gaussian part adds none) and variance 1+σi21 + \sigma_i^21+σi2​, so its normalized kurtosis −1.2/(1+σi2)2-1.2/(1 + \sigma_i^2)^2−1.2/(1+σi2​)2 is nonzero, and it depends on σi2\sigma_i^2σi2​. For ε≠0\varepsilon \neq 0ε=0 the multiset of normalized kurtoses changes from four copies of −0.3-0.3−0.3 to two copies each of −1.2/(2+ε)2-1.2/(2 + \varepsilon)^2−1.2/(2+ε)2 and −1.2/(2−ε)2-1.2/(2 - \varepsilon)^2−1.2/(2−ε)2, so the new sources are not a rescaled permutation of the old ones. The columns are pairwise non-collinear and the sources are non-Gaussian, so A\bAA is identifiable within the class of models described in Section 4.5第 4.5 节 (Theorem 12.1定理 12.1), yet the source distributions are not determined by the distribution of x\bxx.

（a）四个矩阵 aiai⊤\ba_i\ba_i^\topai​ai⊤​ 分别为 (1000)\bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)(10​00​)、12(1111)\tfrac12\bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)21​(11​11​)、(0001)\bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)(00​01​) 与 12(1−1−11)\tfrac12\bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} 1 & -1 \\ -1 & 1 \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)21​(1−1​−11​)；2×22 \times 22×2 对称矩阵构成三维空间，所以它们必然线性相关。事实上 δ=(1,−1,1,−1)\delta = (1, -1, 1, -1)δ=(1,−1,1,−1) 即满足要求：(1,1)(1,1)(1,1) 元为 1−12+0−12=01 - \tfrac12 + 0 - \tfrac12 = 01−21​+0−21​=0，(1,2)(1,2)(1,2) 元为 0−12+0+12=00 - \tfrac12 + 0 + \tfrac12 = 00−21​+0+21​=0，(2,2)(2,2)(2,2) 元为 0−12+1−12=00 - \tfrac12 + 1 - \tfrac12 = 00−21​+1−21​=0。（b）把 x\bxx 写成 x=∑iuiai+g\bx = \sum_i u_i \ba_i + \mathbf{g}x=∑i​ui​ai​+g，其中 g=∑igiai\mathbf{g} = \sum_i g_i \ba_ig=∑i​gi​ai​。两项相互独立，g\mathbf{g}g 是协方差为 ∑iσi2aiai⊤\sum_i \sigma_i^2 \ba_i\ba_i^\top∑i​σi2​ai​ai⊤​ 的高斯向量；把 σi2=1\sigma_i^2 = 1σi2​=1 换成 1+εδi1 + \varepsilon\delta_i1+εδi​（∣ε∣<1|\varepsilon| < 1∣ε∣<1 时为正）不改变这个协方差。第一项也不变，而独立向量之和的分布由各加项的分布决定，所以 x\bxx 的分布不变。（c）每个源 si=ui+gis_i = u_i + g_isi​=ui​+gi​ 的峭度为 −1.2-1.2−1.2（高斯部分不贡献峭度），方差为 1+σi21 + \sigma_i^21+σi2​，所以其归一化峭度 −1.2/(1+σi2)2-1.2/(1 + \sigma_i^2)^2−1.2/(1+σi2​)2 不为零，且随 σi2\sigma_i^2σi2​ 变化。当 ε≠0\varepsilon \neq 0ε=0 时，归一化峭度构成的多重集由四个 −0.3-0.3−0.3 变为各两个 −1.2/(2+ε)2-1.2/(2 + \varepsilon)^2−1.2/(2+ε)2 与 −1.2/(2−ε)2-1.2/(2 - \varepsilon)^2−1.2/(2−ε)2，因此新的源不是旧的源经过尺度变换和置换得到的。各列两两不共线，源都非高斯，所以在Section 4.5第 4.5 节所述的模型类中 A\bAA 可辨识（Theorem 12.1定理 12.1）；然而源的分布并不由 x\bxx 的分布唯一确定。
